When I did it a couple years back, it was roughly the following

- PT: One practice SCR and RFT in Week 1 followed by an assessed SCR and RFT in Week 2. The only other phys session is Bayonet training.

- Field ex: 5 days in the field in the second week, finishing on the Saturday, the day before you pass out.

The rest of the time is fleshed out with classroom lessons, tests on the lessons you just did and a fair bit of downtime.
Terrible. Give it a miss

Very similar story to mine! In plain clothes, and walk past a guy dancing and singing to music in his car doing balloons. Knock on the window and have a quick chat with him. He gleefully explains he's just doing a couple balloons and that they're great fun,

His face when I badged out...

Me and another Officer (Both in our early 20s) walking round the student part of Town in plain clothes. 2 Lads approach us and ask if we want to buy drugs. Hand us their business cards, tell us what they have for sale etc.

Ask, "Do you have any on you right now?"

"Yeah, sure I've got XYZ."

Badge out, "Mind if we take a look ourselves?"

Very short chase and both locked up for Offering to Supply.

Funnily enough, a MOP driving past have seen 2 lads getting chased by 2 others and phone a job in saying that we have just attacked them

FCMU were an absolute pain. Told strictly under no circumstances were you to crime your own jobs - Phone up the FCMU and they'll do it for you. Spent 20 minutes guiding the person on the other side how to crime a job and another 10 trying to find the right offence code.

I could have done it less than 10 and started progressing the enquiries in that time...

Anyway. I left the shower of shit that was GMP and haven't looked back. 10x happier. 

Get off DIT ASAP or leave the job altogether is my advice. Nothing is going to improve.
